entities.name: Joanna
entities.description: Screenwriter and author, and the friend Nate talks with through 2022. She finished her first full screenplay on 21 January 2022, a second by 18 March, a third by 20 May, started a book in July, and had scripts she contributed to reach the big screen in June and October 2022; by 11 November 2022 she was filming her own movie. She is lactose intolerant and severely allergic to furred animals and reptiles, hikes for inspiration, bakes dairy-free desserts, keeps a stuffed dog called Tilly beside her while she writes, and joined a writers group on 21 April 2022.

entities.name: Nate
entities.description: Competitive video gamer who turned gaming into a living during 2022 — his first tournament win came in January, an international win in August and a Valorant final in November — and who by November 2022 was weighing offers from new teams and making gaming videos for YouTube. He also makes dairy-free and vegan desserts, above all coconut milk ice cream, and presented recipes on his own cooking show on 12 September 2022. He keeps turtles, two until he bought a third in November 2022, and adopted a dog called Max in May 2022. He is Joanna's friend and her steadiest supporter.

entities.name: Nate's turtles
entities.description: Nate's pet turtles, kept for about three years as of January 2022 and referred to throughout as his little guys, little dudes, little buddies or these critters. There were two — one adventurous, one reserved — until he bought a third in November 2022; they got a larger tank in August 2022, eat vegetables, fruit and insects, are taken out for walks and to the beach, and are what Nate turns to for calm. Joanna, who is allergic to reptiles, follows them only through his photographs or from a distance.

properties.aliases: the turtles; my little dudes; my little guys; my little buddies; these critters; these little guys

entities.name: writing
entities.description: Joanna's vocation and the thread running through the whole conversation: screenplays, a book, a blog post, a journal and written-down memories. She says it lets her build worlds, express her feelings and heal, and it is what gets her through hard times. Nate said in March 2022 that he wanted to pursue writing too and asked her for advice.

entities.name: competitive video gaming
entities.description: Nate's hobby turned career. In January 2022 he played mainly for fun and did not expect to win big; by August 2022 he was making a living from tournaments, and by November 2022 he was making gaming videos for YouTube between them. He also calls playing games his escape from life's struggles, which is why he does not get very competitive about them.

entities.name: hiking
entities.description: Joanna's way of resetting and finding inspiration. She found a trail in her hometown on 16 April 2022, more trails in her town in May 2022 including Whispering Falls, called herself an expert hiker by 12 May 2022, and hikes with friends. Nate says he is not into hiking but does like nature and agreed to join her on the trails sometime.

entities.name: dairy-free dessert making
entities.description: Making dairy-free and vegan desserts, which both Nate and Joanna do and which they trade recipes over all year. Nate discovered he could make coconut milk ice cream by 7 February 2022, began teaching others by August 2022 and presented vegan recipes on his own cooking show on 12 September 2022; Joanna, who is lactose intolerant, took it up from his recipes and developed her own cakes, tarts and cupcakes for her family and friends.

entities.name: Joanna's animal allergy
entities.description: Joanna's severe allergy to most reptiles and to animals with fur, and to cockroaches, which she found she also reacted to by March 2022. Her face becomes puffy and itchy around certain animals, so she has always kept away from them. It cost her her childhood dog Tilly, it is why she has no pets of her own, and it is why she watches Nate's turtles only in photographs or from a distance.

entities.name: Joanna's lactose intolerance
entities.description: Joanna cannot have dairy. It is why she asks Nate for dairy-free recipes, why she bakes with coconut and almond milk, and why she cannot eat the ice cream he makes for other people.

entities.name: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive
entities.description: The team shooter Nate won his first video game tournament playing, in the week before 21 January 2022, and his usual competitive game.

entities.name: the romantic drama about memory and relationships
entities.description: An unnamed romantic drama about memory and relationships that Joanna calls one of her favourites. She first watched it around three years before January 2022, went out and bought a physical copy, has seen it several times, and recommended it to Nate on 21 January 2022 for its idea and its acting.

properties.aliases: the romantic drama about memory and relationships; that movie

entities.name: Little Women
entities.description: The film Joanna watched shortly before 7 February 2022 and recommended to Nate as a must-see for its story of sisterhood, love and reaching for your dreams. He watched it shortly before 6 October 2022 and thought the acting and story excellent.

entities.name: Joanna's first screenplay
entities.description: Joanna's first full screenplay, a mix of drama and romance, finished and printed on Friday 21 January 2022 after a long stretch of work. Finishing it left her feeling relief, excitement and anxiety at once. She submitted it to film festivals hoping a producer or director would take it up, and by 3 June 2022 had received a generic rejection letter, with no feedback, from a major company.

entities.name: Joanna's second screenplay
entities.description: The screenplay Joanna started around 25 February 2022 and finished by 18 March 2022, about a thirty-year-old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss who takes a road trip to heal and grow; she says it is her own story, drawn from her own experiences. Joined here to the road-trip script she began filming as her own movie by 11 November 2022, on the road trip at the centre of both.

entities.name: Joanna's writers group
entities.description: The group of writers Joanna joined on 21 April 2022 and also calls her writing club. She found it full of inspirational people who really understand her writing and said it made her feel she finally belonged somewhere. With the group she worked on the script 'Finding Home'; she shared her book with them for feedback in the week before 22 August 2022 and made a bookmark for one of its members in early October 2022.

properties.aliases: my writers group; my writing club

entities.name: Finding Home
entities.description: A script about a girl on a journey to find her true home, which Joanna was writing with her writers group in April 2022 and found rewarding and emotional. Kept apart from the third screenplay she finished a month later, because that one she describes as a solitary and deeply personal story she had held for years rather than work done with the group.

entities.name: The Lord of the Rings trilogy
entities.description: The fantasy trilogy Nate named as one of his favourites on 21 April 2022, for its world building, battles and storytelling. Joanna watched it on his recommendation on 1 May 2022 and thought it awesome; Nate called it probably the greatest trilogy of all time.

entities.name: Street Fighter
entities.description: The fighting game Nate plays a lot with his friends. He entered a local Street Fighter tournament rather than his usual Counter-Strike and won it in the week before 2 May 2022 — his second tournament win — discovering he was really good at it.

entities.name: Whispering Falls
entities.description: A waterfall Joanna found and photographed on a hike in her town in the week before 12 May 2022. She described it as peaceful and serene, said the rush of the water was soothing, and said that everything else faded away there.

entities.name: Joanna's third screenplay
entities.description: Joanna's third screenplay, finished by 20 May 2022, about loss, identity and connection. She called it deeply personal — a story she had had for ages but only then found the guts to write — and said writing it was hard and scary but that she is proudest of it. She submitted it to a film contest on 24 June 2022 and had a rejection from a production company by 21 October 2022.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: The dog Nate adopted around 20 May 2022, full of energy, who filled his life with joy and keeps his turtles active. Walking Max is how Nate met a friendly couple with a dog who live nearby, with whom he arranged doggy playdates.

entities.name: Tilly the stuffed dog
entities.description: The stuffed toy dog Nate gave Joanna on 25 May 2022 as a reminder of good vibes — joy in your pocket, as he put it. Joanna named her Tilly, after the dog she had as a child in Michigan, and keeps her close while she writes; she says Tilly helps her stay focused and brings her joy.

entities.name: Nate's gaming setup
entities.description: The gaming room and computer Nate keeps at home — desk, monitors, headphones and a gaming chair — where he practises and competes and sometimes plays with friends. He upgraded the equipment shortly before 7 November 2022 and calls it his own little haven and something his career depends on.

entities.name: Woodhaven
entities.description: A small town in the American Midwest that Joanna visited on a research road trip in early July 2022. She saw lovely scenery and historic buildings there and found a book from the 1900s of stories and sketches about the town in its library; Woodhaven's past and how much it had changed sparked the ideas for her next script.

entities.name: Joanna's book
entities.description: The book Joanna started writing by 10 July 2022, after her film did well: a deep and emotional story whose dialogue explores loss, redemption and forgiveness. She had never tried publishing a book before and thought this might be her first. She shared it with her writers group in the week before 22 August 2022 and got great feedback, and finished writing it in the week before 6 October 2022 after many late nights and edits.

entities.name: Joanna's Midwestern thriller script
entities.description: The script Joanna's July 2022 visit to Woodhaven sparked, which she said was different from her previous work and had the potential to be something awesome. Joined here to the new project she described by 9 November 2022 as a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town, on the small-Midwestern-town setting Woodhaven gave her; she calls it a great creative outlet.

entities.name: Catan
entities.description: The strategy board game of building settlements and trading resources that Nate loves and played with people he met at the game convention on 7 October 2022; he says it can be either competitive or relaxed and that they managed both.

entities.name: Cyberpunk 2077
entities.description: The game with a futuristic setting and gameplay that Nate said on 9 October 2022 he had been playing nonstop.

entities.name: Inception
entities.description: The film Nate watched shortly before 9 October 2022, which he said blew his mind with all its twists and dream material.

entities.name: Tilly
entities.description: The dog Joanna had when she lived in Michigan; the family had to give her away when Joanna became allergic. Joanna named the stuffed dog Nate gave her after this Tilly, because the name reminds her of when she could hold and squeeze an animal without an allergic reaction.

properties.aliases: Tilly; the dog I used to have back in Michigan

entities.name: Michigan
entities.description: Where Joanna lived when she had her childhood dog Tilly, before an allergy meant the family had to give her away.

entities.name: Fort Wayne
entities.description: The place Joanna was hiking near in the summer of 2022 when she took the sunset photograph she showed Nate on 9 November 2022.

entities.name: Tampa
entities.description: Where Nate took his turtles to the beach on 10 November 2022.

entities.name: Valorant
entities.description: The game of the big tournament Nate reached the final of and won on Saturday 5 November 2022; he said seeing his name as the champion was the best feeling.

entities.name: Xenoblade Chronicles
entities.description: The Japanese fantasy role-playing game Nate was playing on 7 November 2022 and highly recommended to Joanna. He is a big fan of Nintendo games and had wanted to play this one for a while because his friends had recommended it.

entities.name: Joanna's love story script
entities.description: The film script Joanna was writing in November 2022 — a love story with lots of challenges, whose idea came to her in a dream — which she hoped to get onto the big screen. She finished its introduction by 7 November 2022 and chose to open it with a letter her brother wrote her when they were children.

claims.text: Joanna and Nate agreed on 25 May 2022 that appreciating small joys is what makes life better and keeps a person from getting down.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said on 25 May 2022 that thinking back to the hard times finishing her screenplay had made her realise it is those moments that bring joy and make the journey worth it; she was eager to show the screenplay to Nate because she values his opinion.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: After finishing her screenplay Joanna received a rejection letter from a major company, some time before 3 June 2022. It was a generic letter with no feedback, which she found disheartening because she did not know why it had not worked out, but she resolved not to let it bring her down.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate won another regional video game tournament in the week before 3 June 2022 and met new people there; he said the win was a huge confidence boost and showed his hard work had paid off.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna said on 3 June 2022 that she enjoys hearing about Nate's tournaments over the years and that she is there for him every step of the way.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Some of the gamers Nate talked to at the tournament wanted to hang out with him later and asked him for tips on improving their play, which he agreed to give; he said he simply likes helping people.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna planned to hike a new trail with a waterfall, with friends, over the weekend of 4 and 5 June 2022.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate was organising a gaming party for the weekend of 18 and 19 June 2022, inviting the friends he had made at tournaments along with old friends and teammates, and giving every guest custom controller decorations for coming.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: A screenplay Joanna had written a few parts of appeared on the big screen on 4 June 2022; she found it nerve-wracking but inspiring to see her words come alive, and called seeing the hard work pay off amazing.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Spider-Man has always been Joanna's favourite superhero — she likes Peter Parker's struggle between being a hero and being a person — though she says she is a sucker for any superhero. Nate had noticed a Spider-Man pin on her purse the last time they met.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Iron Man is Nate's favourite superhero, for his technology and sarcastic humour. He keeps an Iron Man figure in his room because it reminds him of something he loves and its presence reminds him to keep working on his goals.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna keeps a cork board covered with inspiring quotes, photographs and small keepsakes as her own corner of inspiration. It includes a picture of her family, which she hung there because it reminds her every day of their love and encouragement.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate said on 5 June 2022 that he really should start a cork board of his own, and Joanna recommended it, joking that he would have to be willing to explain it to his friends.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna submitted her most recent screenplay to a film contest on 24 June 2022, to see how other people would take to it.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's gaming party was a success: seven people attended, six of them said they would want to do it again the following month, and they played chess afterwards for fun. Most of the guests liked the custom controller accessories he had given out, though he could not say whether they would all keep using them.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate made vegan ice cream on Friday 17 June 2022 and shared it with people from his vegan diet group.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: On 24 June 2022 Nate agreed to give Joanna his vegan ice cream recipe the next day, and she planned to make it for her family over the weekend of 25 and 26 June 2022; she said her family love it when she makes them new things.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate won his fourth video game tournament on Friday 8 July 2022, this one held online; he said the victory was indescribable and that he is proud to be making money doing what he loves.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna took a road trip in early July 2022 to do research for her next film, treating it as a much-needed break and a chance to explore new places and get inspired.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: On that road trip Joanna went to Woodhaven, a small town in the Midwest, where she saw lovely scenery and historic buildings and visited the town library, which had a collection of old books.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: In the Woodhaven library Joanna found a book from the 1900s of stories and sketches about the town and the people who lived there; reading about Woodhaven's interesting past and how much it had changed sparked the ideas for her next script.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said on 10 July 2022 that she was excited about her new script, that it is different from her previous work, and that it has the potential to be something awesome.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna started writing a book by 10 July 2022, after her movie did well; the page she showed Nate holds dialogue exploring loss, redemption and forgiveness, and she called it a deep and emotional story she was excited about.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna had never tried publishing a book before and said on 10 July 2022 that this one might be her first; Nate expected readers to recognise her as the author of the film she had published and to love the book even more.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: By 14 August 2022 Joanna was busy with writing projects and going all out with them, calling it a mix of highs and lows with her journal as her rock. She said writing had become an escape and a way to express her feelings, and that words have a magical way of healing.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: In the week before 14 August 2022 someone wrote Joanna a letter after reading an online blog post she had written about a hard moment in her life, saying her story had brought them comfort. She found it moving to realise her words had that power, and said it reminded her why she loves writing.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Between 10 July and 14 August 2022 Nate started teaching people how to make dairy-free desserts, and found sharing his love of them fun and rewarding.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: By 14 August 2022 Nate had a new dairy-free dessert recipe — creamy and rich — that he had been making a lot, and he sent it to Joanna, who planned to surprise her family with it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate won an international video game tournament on 21 August 2022 and said gaming had brought him so much success that he was now able to make a living from something he is passionate about.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's turtles got a new, larger tank shortly before 22 August 2022; he said the expansion had made them happy and given them much more room, and that they are always calm and peaceful and make coming home after a long day of gaming better.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna shared her book with her writers group in the week before 22 August 2022. She was very nervous but got great feedback, felt her hard work was paying off, and celebrated by making herself a dessert.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate planned to take the weekend of 27 and 28 August 2022 off and spend it relaxing with his pets.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna planned to spend the weekend of 27 and 28 August 2022 relaxing and recharging with a long walk and some reading.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said on 22 August 2022 that she has learned that taking breaks and looking after herself matter for her inspiration and her mental health, and that it is all about finding balance.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna recommended on 22 August 2022 that Nate find a fantasy book series to read through, saying most fiction series are good reads when you are trying to relax, and she approved of the series he picked out.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate recommended a book series to Joanna in return on 22 August 2022, praising its battles, characters, action scenes and plot and calling it one of his favourites; she said she would add it to her list.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate did badly in a video game tournament shortly before 5 September 2022 despite trying; he called it a setback and part of the learning curve, was trying to stay positive, and said spending time with his turtles had been a big help.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna revised one of her old recipes shortly before 5 September 2022 and made it; she said tinkering with that recipe and others was giving her comfort and a way to be creative.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: By 5 September 2022 Joanna was experimenting with chocolate, raspberry and coconut flavours, and had made dairy-free chocolate coconut cupcakes with raspberry frosting. Being lactose intolerant she bakes only dairy-free, using coconut or almond milk, and enjoys the challenge of making treats that suit everyone's diets.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said on 5 September 2022 that she had been making all sorts of desserts that suit everyone's diets — cookies, pies and cakes — and would share more recipes with Nate; he asked to join her sometime, saying baking and cooking really bring people together.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's tips for dairy-free baking, given on 5 September 2022, are to use dairy-free margarine or coconut oil in place of butter and to check the labels to be sure they are dairy-free.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's laptop crashed in the week before 14 September 2022 and she lost all her work, none of which was recoverable. She called the laptop half her lifeline as a writer and said the loss was a major blow; she has since bought an external drive for backups so it cannot happen again.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate taught people vegan ice cream recipes on his own cooking show on Monday 12 September 2022. He found putting himself out there nerve-wracking but a blast, and picked up a few new recipes from it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's favourite dish from his cooking show is coconut milk ice cream, which he calls smooth and creamy with a tropical twist and dairy-free for people who cannot have lactose or who want vegan options; he agreed to share the recipe with Joanna.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna made a dessert with almond milk on Friday 9 September 2022 and thought it good; she said dairy-free is a must for her, especially for desserts.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Besides coconut milk ice cream, Nate loves a dairy-free chocolate mousse, which he says is super creamy and tastes like the real thing.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's favourite dairy-free treat is a chocolate raspberry tart with an almond flour crust, chocolate ganache and fresh raspberries.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna loves making a dairy-free chocolate cake with raspberries, made from almond flour, coconut oil, chocolate and raspberries; she calls it moist and perfectly sweet and makes it for birthdays and special days.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna also makes a creamy dessert from blueberries, coconut milk and a gluten-free crust, and shared the recipe with Nate on 14 September 2022.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna tried her newest dairy-free recipe on 5 October 2022 and it was a winner with her family; she said mixing and matching flavours is fun and that she is always trying new things.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate won a really big video game tournament in the week before 6 October 2022 and made a great deal of money from it. He saved some but was not sure what to do with it, saying he is completely content and has no big plans, and that having the extra cash means he no longer has to stress about money and can just enjoy his films and games.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate watched Little Women shortly before 6 October 2022, on the recommendation Joanna had given him back in February, and thought the acting awesome and the story captivating; Joanna, who had watched it herself, said its themes of sisterhood, love and chasing dreams really spoke to her.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna finished writing her book in the week before 6 October 2022, after a great many late nights and edits, and said she is very proud of it and cannot wait to see what happens next.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate made Joanna an encouragement board, drawn on a whiteboard, so that she could look back on it whenever she needed encouragement; he said her life path is itself inspirational and that encouragement is what got him so far in his gaming career.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna made a bookmark for one of the women at her writing club shortly before 6 October 2022; she said she absolutely loves DIY projects and knows the recipient does too.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate went to a game convention on Friday 7 October 2022 and met people from outside his usual circle. He found it a bit overwhelming but said it reminded him of the good times gaming can bring, and that taking risks leads to great experiences.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: At the game convention Nate made friends who love games as much as he does, and they had already planned a gaming session together.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: At the convention Nate joined a group playing Catan, a strategy board game of building settlements and trading resources that he loves; they had a lot in common and hit it off, and although they played competitively it stayed relaxed and fun.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate said on 9 October 2022 that playing games is his escape from life's struggles, so he does not generally get very competitive about them, and that the people at the convention were the same way.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate suggested on 9 October 2022 that Joanna go to a writing convention; she had not known such things existed and said she would look into it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate spends his evenings at home mostly playing video games or watching films to unwind.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate watched Inception shortly before 9 October 2022 and said it blew his mind with all its twists and dream material; he had also been playing Cyberpunk 2077 nonstop, for its futuristic setting and gameplay.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna watched a classic film shortly before 9 October 2022 with a gripping story and great acting that really stuck with her, and rated it nine or ten out of ten.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate and Joanna agreed on 9 October 2022 that films take them to new worlds, make them feel things they would not normally feel, and are a good way to chill out after a day.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna has a living room set up for comfortable film watching, which she prefers to a cinema; when Nate said he should get something similar she advised a couch big enough for several people and fluffy enough to lie down on, a blanket with some weight to it, and lights that can be dimmed.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said on 9 October 2022 that she gets deeply invested in small things like her living room, and that it is worth it for the little things that make life nicer.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: By 21 October 2022 Joanna had been revising and perfecting the recipe she made for her family, and it had turned out really tasty.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate was stressed as of 21 October 2022 about his progress in tournaments, because of tough competitors, and said his turtles always cheer him up.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna still has the stuffed dog Nate gave her in May 2022. She has named her Tilly and keeps her nearby while she writes, and says Tilly helps her stay focused and brings her a great deal of joy.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna named the stuffed dog Tilly after a dog of that name she used to have back in Michigan, which the family had to give away when she became allergic; the name reminds her of when she could hold and squeeze an animal without an allergic reaction.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate was practising for his next video game tournament as of 21 October 2022.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna had another rejection from a production company shortly before 21 October 2022, for the screenplay she had sent to a film contest. She found it hard but said she would keep grinding and moving ahead.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate told Joanna on 21 October 2022 that he respects her for bouncing back whenever something sad happens, and reminded her that she has people cheering her on wherever she goes.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: A film made from another script Joanna contributed to was shown on the big screen for the first time on Sunday 23 October 2022. She called it surreal and satisfying, said she had been waiting for it a long time, and said this was the third time it had happened to her.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said her favourite part of seeing the film was watching the characters she had worked so hard on come alive, as though they had jumped off the page and become real.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna draws her characters as visuals to help bring them alive in her head so that she can write them better, and takes ideas for them from everywhere — people she knows, things she has seen, and things she imagines.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna refused on 25 October 2022 to tell Nate about one of the characters in her drawings and told him to watch the film and find out; he said he had already planned to and now wanted to even more.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate took his turtles out for a walk on 25 October 2022 because he was bored, and afterwards they rested in their tank, tired from the walking.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's turtles eat a varied diet of vegetables, fruit and insects. He most enjoys watching them eat fruit, because they get excited about it, and he also likes holding them.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate said on 25 October 2022 that each of his turtles has its own personality — one more adventurous, the other more reserved — and that having them around brings him joy and makes them great companions.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate has liked turtles since he was a boy and says he knows all about them; Joanna said she never knew turtles could be so interesting until she met his.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna set up and held meetings with movie producers shortly before 4 November 2022. They went really well: she felt confident discussing her script and her vision, the producers seemed interested and excited and loved the elements of self-discovery in it, and she came away feeling validated, hopeful and inspired.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: In the week before 4 November 2022 Joanna found old notebooks holding her early writing, and enjoyed seeing how far she had come.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna still remembers a story she wrote when she was ten, about a brave little turtle who was scared but explored the world anyway; she thinks she was already drawn then to stories about finding courage and taking risks, and says that is still part of her writing. She added that turtles make her think of strength and perseverance and motivate her in tough times.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Besides her producer meetings, Joanna was working on a project she found challenging but fulfilling as of 4 November 2022.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate had been helping friends reset their high scores at the international tournament as of 4 November 2022, and said it feels good to use his skills to make a difference.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate made coconut milk ice cream on 3 November 2022 and invited Joanna over to try it, telling her it was lactose-free. She arranged to come the next day, 5 November 2022, and to bring some of her own recipes so they could share desserts; Nate said he had been wanting to try her chocolate and raspberry cake.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate reached the final of a big Valorant tournament on Saturday 5 November 2022 and won it. He said seeing his name as the champion was the best feeling and that tournaments bring out strong emotions in him.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna finished her presentation for producers on Friday 4 November 2022; she found it tough but thought it was looking good.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate was busy preparing for further tournaments as of 7 November 2022 and loving it, and said he is grateful to have a job he enjoys every day.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna was writing another film script as of 7 November 2022 — a love story with lots of challenges — which she had got the idea for from a dream and hoped to get onto the big screen.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate said on 7 November 2022 that his turtles were doing well and that watching them is calming and fascinating and that he has grown very fond of them.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna said on 7 November 2022 that creating stories and watching them come alive is what gives her happiness and fulfilment, and that writing has been a blessing for her.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna submitted several more scripts in the week before 7 November 2022 and expected a few of them to be rejected; Nate predicted that at least one would reach the screens and become her third published movie.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate upgraded some of his home equipment shortly before 7 November 2022. His computer is where he practises and competes and sometimes plays with friends; he calls the space his own little haven for escaping into the virtual world and says he could never beat his competition without it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate was playing a fantasy role-playing game called Xenoblade Chronicles as of 7 November 2022 and highly recommended it to Joanna. He is a big fan of Nintendo games and had wanted to play this one for a while because friends of his had played and recommended it; he said he likes recommendations from friends, just as he likes Joanna's film recommendations.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna finished the introduction to her next film script by 7 November 2022 and decided to open it with a letter her brother wrote her when they were children; he used to make her such notes, and it brings back sweet memories of a simpler time.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate had a special day taking his pets to the park, where they were amazed and their happy faces made the day memorable for him; he said mixing new memories with old ones is priceless.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna had started writing down some of her favourite memories by 7 November 2022; Nate said he would start doing the same, writing down the things his animals like and his favourite memories with her.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's game tournament was pushed back, so in the days before 9 November 2022 he tried some cooking instead and made homemade coconut ice cream, whose colour the sprinkles changed this time.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate did not make it to the finals of his last tournament before 9 November 2022; he called it a tough tournament but said he would get them next time and that staying positive is key.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate was thinking of joining a new gaming team after his next tournament as of 9 November 2022. He had received a few offers but had not decided, and called it a big step and a shake-up he was ready for.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna worked out a plan for getting another of her scripts made into a movie and pitched it to producers on 8 November 2022; they really liked it, which gave her a big confidence boost.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna was working on a new project by 9 November 2022 — a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town — which she called a great creative outlet.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate started creating gaming content for YouTube by 9 November 2022, as a way to entertain people and satisfy his video game cravings when there are no tournaments on. He is a fan of such videos himself and hopes to share his love of gaming and connect with others who enjoy it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna advised Nate on 9 November 2022 to watch other people's gaming videos first so that he would know what his audience likes and his own videos would not flop; he said he was already doing that.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna photographed a sunset on a hike near Fort Wayne in the summer of 2022, and called the sunset and the beauty around it an awesome reminder of nature's beauty.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate bought a third turtle at a pet store shortly before 9 November 2022, because their tank was by then big enough for three; he said turtles bring him joy and peace and that he is very happy with the decision.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna arranged to visit Nate on 10 November 2022 to watch him play with his turtles from a distance, because of her allergy; they also planned to watch one of her movies together or go to the park, and Nate said he would give the turtles a bath before she arrived.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: By 11 November 2022 Joanna was filming her own movie, made from her road-trip screenplay. She called it wild to see it come alive, said every day on set is full of potential, and said being able to show her vision is awesome.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's best moment on the set of her film was when one of the actors came up to her and said how much she liked the script, which gave Joanna chills.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate took his turtles to the beach in Tampa on 10 November 2022, and said they always bring him peace amid the craziness of life.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate said on 11 November 2022 that he loves having his turtles around because they make him feel calm, need little looking after, and are like zen masters that remind him to slow down and appreciate the small things; he likes seeing them soak up the sun.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate was experimenting with ice cream flavours as of 11 November 2022 and made several colourful bowls of coconut milk ice cream with mix-ins, which he offered to Joanna to try.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's screenwriting career moved through 2022 from finishing her first full screenplay on 21 January, through a rejection from a major company by 3 June and another from a production company by 21 October, to producer meetings and a successful pitch in early November and, by 11 November 2022, filming her own movie from her road-trip script.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's gaming went from a hobby he played for fun, with his first tournament win in January 2022 and no expectation of winning big, to a living: an international win on 21 August 2022, a large cash prize in early October, a Valorant championship on 5 November, and by 9 November 2022 offers from new teams and a YouTube gaming channel of his own.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's household grew through 2022: two turtles he had kept for about three years as of January, a dog called Max adopted around 20 May, and a third turtle bought shortly before 9 November 2022.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's dairy-free dessert making grew from first discovering he could make coconut milk ice cream by 7 February 2022, through teaching other people how to make such desserts from mid-2022, to presenting vegan ice cream recipes on his own cooking show on 12 September 2022.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna took up dairy-free baking after Nate's recommendations, going from asking him for a recipe on 25 February 2022 to developing her own dairy-free cakes, tarts and cupcakes through 2022 and making them for her family and friends.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's hiking grew through 2022 from finding a trail in her hometown on 16 April, to finding more trails in her town including Whispering Falls by 12 May, when she called herself an expert hiker, to hiking new trails with friends in June.
claims.speaker: Joanna
